# stripe_core_event_destination (Data Source)

A destination for Stripe's events, delivered as thin or snapshot payloads: a webhook endpoint, an Amazon EventBridge partner event source or an Azure Event Grid partner topic. `terraform destroy` deletes the destination. The destination's signing secret is not available yet. `status` is read-only: Terraform cannot enable or disable a destination yet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_core_event_destination" "billing" {
  id = stripe_core_event_destination.billing.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the object.

### Read-Only

- `amazon_eventbridge` (Attributes) AWS account and region where Stripe creates the EventBridge partner event source. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--amazon_eventbridge))
- `azure_event_grid` (Attributes) Azure subscription, resource group, and region where Stripe creates the partner topic. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--azure_event_grid))
- `created` (String) The time when the destination was created.
- `description` (String) An optional user-defined description of the destination's purpose.
- `enabled_events` (List of String) The list of event types enabled for delivery to this destination.
- `event_payload` (String) Whether to deliver as snapshot or thin events. Possible values: `snapshot`, `thin`.
- `events_from` (List of String) The account or organization scopes that can supply events. Use this with `enabled_events` to define the subscription.
`@self`: Receive events from the account that owns the event destination.
`@accounts`: Receive events emitted from other accounts you manage, including your v1 and v2 accounts.
`@organization_members`: Receive events from accounts directly linked to the organization.
`@organization_members/@accounts`: Receive events from all accounts connected to any platform accounts in the organization.
- `livemode` (Boolean) Has the value `true` if the object exists in live mode or the value `false` if the object exists in test mode.
- `metadata` (Map of String) User-defined key/value data for the destination.
- `name` (String) A user-defined label for identifying the destination.
- `snapshot_api_version` (String) For snapshot events only, the Stripe API version used to render event objects; do not provide this for thin events.
- `status` (String) Whether Stripe currently attempts delivery. Stripe attempts delivery to enabled destinations when their provider configuration is active; disabled destinations do not receive delivery attempts. Possible values: `disabled`, `enabled`.
- `status_details` (Attributes) Additional lifecycle context for the destination status, when available. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_details))
- `type` (String) The delivery transport. Chosen when the destination is created and cannot be changed by update. Possible values: `amazon_eventbridge`, `azure_event_grid`, `webhook_endpoint`.
- `updated` (String) The time when the destination object was last updated.
- `webhook_endpoint` (Attributes) Delivery target for the webhook endpoint. Live mode requires HTTPS; sandbox mode also supports HTTP. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--webhook_endpoint))

<a id="nestedatt--amazon_eventbridge"></a>
### Nested Schema for `amazon_eventbridge`

Read-Only:

- `aws_account_id` (String) Your AWS account where Stripe creates the partner event source.
- `aws_event_source_arn` (String) The ARN of the Stripe-created partner event source in your AWS account.
- `aws_event_source_status` (String) The AWS-reported lifecycle state of the partner event source. Possible values: `active`, `deleted`, `pending`, `unknown`.
- `aws_region` (String) The AWS region where Stripe creates the partner event source.


<a id="nestedatt--azure_event_grid"></a>
### Nested Schema for `azure_event_grid`

Read-Only:

- `azure_partner_topic_name` (String) The name of the Stripe-created partner topic that receives events.
- `azure_partner_topic_status` (String) The Azure-reported lifecycle state of the partner topic. Possible values: `activated`, `deleted`, `never_activated`, `unknown`.
- `azure_region` (String) The Azure region where Stripe creates the partner topic.
- `azure_resource_group_name` (String) The Azure resource group where Stripe creates the partner topic.
- `azure_subscription_id` (String) The Azure subscription where Stripe creates the partner topic.


<a id="nestedatt--status_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status_details`

Read-Only:

- `disabled` (Attributes) Present when the destination was disabled; identifies the cause, time, and provider-side object involved when available. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_details--disabled))

<a id="nestedatt--status_details--disabled"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status_details.disabled`

Read-Only:

- `reason` (String) Reason event destination has been disabled. Possible values: `no_aws_event_source_exists`, `no_azure_partner_topic_exists`, `user`.



<a id="nestedatt--webhook_endpoint"></a>
### Nested Schema for `webhook_endpoint`

Read-Only:

- `url` (String) The URL where Stripe sends matching events. Live mode requires HTTPS; sandbox mode also supports HTTP.
